sources.entry: Pexi - Chrome extension for comparing shared tabs with source links, filling forms, and drafting emails with your own AI API key (paid after a 7-day card-backed trial). #paid

summary.name: Pexi
summary.one_liner: Pexi is a Chrome side-panel AI agent that researches, compares shared tabs, fills forms, and drafts emails using your own AI provider API key.
use_cases: Compare options across several open tabs in a table
Research a topic and keep source links
Fill out web forms with AI assistance
Export generated text as Markdown, JSON or CSV
summary.what_it_does: Pexi runs as a side-panel conversation in Chrome that works with the tabs you choose to share. It can compare information across shared tabs and turn it into a table, and it can research a topic while keeping source links with the result. It can fill forms and work through steps on websites you select, and prepare email drafts that it carries out only when you authorize them. Users connect their own API key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or OpenRouter, and conversations stay in one thread with history, prompt reuse, and export.
notable: Bring your own AI key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or OpenRouter
Side-panel chat with shared-tab context and source links
Keeps provider key and history in the local browser profile; does not export website login cookies to the model
caveats: Subscription costs $9/month or $90/year after a 7-day trial that requires a payment card at checkout
AI usage is billed separately by the chosen provider, including during the trial
Sign-in screens, verification challenges, and some protected actions need user participation; output should be reviewed
